---
title: "Cleaning Prolific: RT control and participant exclusions"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script:

1. Keeps the test trials and the participants whose Prolific submission was approved.
2. Keeps the most recent run for each participant and task, and saves these uncleaned files.
3. Removes outlier trials from the RT control block, then flags participants with too few RT control trials or low RT control accuracy.
4. Removes participants who did not pass the RT control from the matching arithmetic tasks.
5. Removes participants who responded very fast (and, for FC, near chance), and plots these cutoffs.
6. Saves the cleaned files used by `get_scores_prolific_df.Rmd`.

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggExtra) # ggMarginal, for the marginal histograms in the exclusion plots
```

# Paths

```{r}
raw_path <- paste0(here("data", "raw", "prolific"), "/")
savepath <- paste0(here("data"), "/")
dir.create(paste0(savepath, "cleaning_prolific"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load the raw data

```{r}
rt_block <- read.csv(paste0(raw_path, "rt-block.csv"))
arf_production <- read.csv(paste0(raw_path, "arf-production.csv"))
arf_2afc <- read.csv(paste0(raw_path, "arf-2afc.csv"))
calf_production <- read.csv(paste0(raw_path, "calf-production.csv"))
calf_6afc <- read.csv(paste0(raw_path, "calf-6afc.csv"))
prolific_demo <- read.csv(paste0(raw_path, "prolific_demo.csv"))

rt_block <- rt_block %>% filter(assessment_stage == "test_response")
arf_production <- arf_production %>% filter(assessment_stage == "test_response")
arf_2afc <- arf_2afc %>% filter(assessment_stage == "test_response")
calf_production <- calf_production %>% filter(assessment_stage == "test_response")
calf_6afc <- calf_6afc %>% filter(assessment_stage == "test_response")
```

# Keep approved participants

```{r}
approved_pids<-prolific_demo %>%
  filter(Status == "APPROVED")

rt_block<-rt_block %>%
  filter(ID %in% approved_pids$ID)

arf_production<-arf_production %>%
  filter(ID %in% approved_pids$ID)

arf_2afc<-arf_2afc %>%
  filter(ID %in% approved_pids$ID)

calf_production<-calf_production %>%
  filter(ID %in% approved_pids$ID)

calf_6afc<-calf_6afc %>%
  filter(ID %in% approved_pids$ID)
```

```{r}
check_data<-function(data){
  print(data %>%
    mutate(date=substr(timeStarted,start = 1, stop = 10)) %>%
    distinct(ID,date) %>%
    count(date, name = "count"))
}

check_data(rt_block)
check_data(arf_production)
check_data(arf_2afc)
check_data(calf_production)
check_data(calf_6afc)
```

# Keep the most recent run

```{r}
get_recentRun<-function(data){
  runIds<-data %>%
    distinct(ID,runId,timeStarted) %>%
    arrange(ID, desc(timeStarted)) %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pull(runId)

  data %>%
    filter(runId %in% runIds)
}

arf_production<-get_recentRun(arf_production)
arf_2afc<-get_recentRun(arf_2afc)
calf_production<-get_recentRun(calf_production)
calf_6afc<-get_recentRun(calf_6afc)

latest_run_incomplete<-rt_block %>%
  group_by(ID,runId,timeStarted) %>%
  summarise(n_blocks=n_distinct(corpus_name), .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(ID, desc(timeStarted)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_blocks<3) %>%
  pull(ID)

mostRecentRuns_rt<-rt_block %>%
  distinct(ID,runId,timeStarted) %>%
  arrange(ID, desc(timeStarted)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(order=row_number()) %>%
  filter(order==1 | (ID %in% latest_run_incomplete & order==2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(runId)

rt_block<-rt_block %>%
  filter(runId %in% mostRecentRuns_rt)

# save the data
write.csv(rt_block,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/rt-block-init.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arf_production,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/arf-production-init.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arf_2afc,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/arf-2afc-init.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_production,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/calf-production-init.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_6afc,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/calf-6afc-init.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# RT control

## Remove outlier trials

```{r}
rt_block_out<-rt_block %>%
  group_by(ID, corpus_name) %>%
  mutate(median_absolute_deviation=mad(rt),
         median_rt=median(rt)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rt_filter_criteria=case_when(corpus_name=="2afc" ~ 5*median_absolute_deviation,
                                      corpus_name=="6afc" ~ 5*median_absolute_deviation,
                                      corpus_name=="production" ~ 5*median_absolute_deviation),
         rt_distance_median = rt-median_rt)%>%
  filter(rt_distance_median<=rt_filter_criteria) %>%
  dplyr::select(-median_rt)

write.csv(rt_block_out,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/rt-block_outliers.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

## Remove participants with not enough trials or low accuracy

```{r}
pid_remove_rt<-rt_block_out %>%
  group_by(ID,corpus_name) %>%
  summarise(proportion_correct=mean(correct),
            n_trials = n()) %>%
  filter((corpus_name == "production" & (n_trials<3 | proportion_correct<0.75)) |
         (corpus_name == "2afc" & (n_trials<5 | proportion_correct<0.875)) |
           (corpus_name == "6afc" & (n_trials<5 | proportion_correct<0.7917))) %>%
  ungroup()

pid_remove_prod<-pid_remove_rt %>%
  filter(corpus_name == "production") %>%
  pull(ID)

pid_remove_2afc<-pid_remove_rt %>%
  filter(corpus_name == "2afc") %>%
  pull(ID)

pid_remove_6afc<-pid_remove_rt %>%
  filter(corpus_name == "6afc") %>%
  pull(ID)
```

```{r}
# Save the cleaned RT control data
rt_block_clean<-rt_block_out %>%
  anti_join(pid_remove_rt, by = c("ID", "corpus_name"))

write.csv(rt_block_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/rt-block_3-75_5-875-7917.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

# Arithmetic tasks

## Remove participants who did not pass the matching RT control

```{r}
arf_production<-arf_production %>%
  filter(!(ID %in% pid_remove_prod))

arf_2afc<-arf_2afc %>%
  filter(!(ID %in% pid_remove_2afc))

calf_production<-calf_production %>%
  filter(!(ID %in% pid_remove_prod))

calf_6afc<-calf_6afc %>%
  filter(!(ID %in% pid_remove_6afc))

write.csv(arf_production,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/arf-production-filteredControl.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arf_2afc,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/arf-2afc-filteredControl.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_production,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/calf-production-filteredControl.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_6afc,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/calf-6afc-filteredControl.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

## Get the median RT and accuracy

```{r}
score_metrics<-function(data){
  data %>%
    mutate(proportion_correct=scores.computed.composite.totalCorrect/scores.computed.composite.totalNumAttempted,
           log_rt=log(rt)) %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    mutate(median_rt=median(rt),
           median_log_rt=median(log_rt)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

arf_prod_out<-score_metrics(arf_production)
arf_2afc_out<-score_metrics(arf_2afc)
calf_prod_out<-score_metrics(calf_production)
calf_6afc_out<-score_metrics(calf_6afc)
```

## Participant exclusion plots

```{r}
plot_exclusion<-function(data, task_label, rt_cut, acc_cut = NULL){
  p<-data %>%
    dplyr::select(ID,median_rt,proportion_correct,group) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=proportion_correct, y=median_rt))+
    geom_point(aes(color = factor(group)), size = 1)+
    geom_hline(yintercept = rt_cut, color = "red")+
    { if (!is.null(acc_cut)) geom_vline(xintercept = acc_cut, color = "red") } +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,0.1), limits = c(0,1)) +
    labs(x=task_label, y="Median RT (ms)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position="none")
  ggMarginal(p, type="histogram")
}

plot_exclusion(arf_prod_out, "ARF FR", rt_cut = 800)
plot_exclusion(arf_2afc_out, "ARF FC", rt_cut = 800, acc_cut = 0.6)
plot_exclusion(calf_prod_out, "CALF FR", rt_cut = 800)
plot_exclusion(calf_6afc_out, "CALF FC", rt_cut = 800, acc_cut = 0.25)
```

## Remove very fast and inaccurate participants

```{r}
arf_prod_clean<-arf_prod_out %>%
 filter(median_rt>=800)

arf_2afc_clean<-arf_2afc_out %>%
 filter(median_rt>=800 | proportion_correct>0.6)

calf_prod_clean<-calf_prod_out %>%
 filter(median_rt>=800)

calf_6afc_clean<-calf_6afc_out %>%
 filter(median_rt>=800 | proportion_correct>0.25)
```

## Save the cleaned data

```{r}
write.csv(arf_prod_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/arf-production-rtFiltered-clean.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arf_2afc_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/arf-2afc-rtFiltered-clean.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_prod_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/calf-production-rtFiltered-clean.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(calf_6afc_clean,paste0(savepath,"cleaning_prolific/calf-6afc-rtFiltered-clean.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```
